_meta.purpose: Curated business descriptions for EDS objects. Consumed by src/introspect.js (injects into per-table pages), src/generate-guide.js (curated guide), and src/generate-ms-description-sql.js (extended properties).
_meta.format: Three key shapes: (1) `<db>.<schema>.<object>` for tables, views, procedures, or functions; (2) `<db>.<schema>.<object>.<column>` for columns on tables/views; (3) cross-DB keys allowed in any shape. Each value is a 1-3 sentence description in plain English. 3-segment keys are resolved against tables/views first, then against procedures/functions; ambiguous names (a table and a routine sharing schema.name) are not supported.
_meta.scope: Curated set of the most load-bearing tables, views, and routines in the EDS production catalog. Add entries as needed; missing entries simply skip injection.
_meta.validation: Run `npm run descriptions:check` before regenerating — every key must reference a real DB / schema / object / column / routine.

EDS.dbo.Requisitions: Header record for every purchase request created in EDS. One row per requisition; line items live in `Detail`. Drives the approval workflow that ultimately produces a PO. Belongs to a District and originating User.
EDS.dbo.Detail: Line items for both requisitions and purchase orders — ~30M rows, the largest transactional table in the procurement chain. Each row links back to its `Requisitions` (and after conversion, to its `PO`) and references either a vendor catalog item via `CrossRefs` or a free-text entry. Pricing, quantities, and account distribution all live here.
EDS.dbo.Approvals: Per-step approval audit trail (~8M rows). Records who approved or rejected each requisition at each level of the district's approval chain, with timestamp and any comment. Combined with `PendingApprovals` to drive the queue an approver sees in the UI.
EDS.dbo.PendingApprovals: Active work queue — one row per (requisition, approver) pair currently awaiting action. Rows are deleted as approvers act; historical record is preserved in `Approvals`.
EDS.dbo.PO: Purchase order header (~2.5M rows). Created when a requisition reaches final approval and is converted. One PO has many `PODetailItems` lines and references the originating `Requisitions` row 1:1.
EDS.dbo.PODetailItems: PO line-item detail (~24.5M rows). Snapshot of item, quantity, unit price, and account split at the moment of PO issuance. Independent from `Detail` — Detail can change after PO issuance, PODetailItems is the immutable contractual record.
EDS.dbo.POStatus: Lookup table of PO lifecycle states (open, partial, received, closed, voided, etc.) joined to `PO` via status code.
EDS.dbo.RequisitionChangeLog: Append-only audit log of edits to requisition headers and lines (~1.9M rows). Captures field-level before/after values with user and timestamp. Used for the requisition history view.
EDS.dbo.DetailChangeLog: Append-only audit log of edits to `Detail` rows (~2.9M rows). Same structure as `RequisitionChangeLog` but scoped to line items.
EDS.dbo.Vendors: Master vendor record — supplier directory for the whole platform (~19K rows). One row per vendor company. The `Active` column (tinyint) gates whether a vendor's catalogs and bid responses are visible to buyers; mutating it has system-wide effect.
EDS.dbo.VendorContacts: Named contacts (sales reps, AP contacts, etc.) attached to a vendor. Used for PO routing, bid notifications, and dispute correspondence.
EDS.dbo.VendorUploads: Log of every vendor catalog or pricing file submitted (~1.5M rows). Tracks file name, vendor, upload type, status, and the eventual import result. Direct writes to `CrossRefs` should always trace back to a row here.
EDS.dbo.Catalog: Vendor-published catalog — a named container that groups a set of `CrossRefs` entries (~4K rows). One vendor may publish multiple catalogs (e.g., per product line or per bid award).
EDS.dbo.CrossRefs: Vendor-item cross-reference (~171M rows — by far the hottest table in EDS). Maps a vendor's part number to an EDS `Items` master record with vendor-specific price, pack size, and effective dates. This is where pricing actually lives. Always filter or `TOP n` when querying — full scans are catastrophic.
EDS.dbo.Items: Master product catalog (~44M rows) — normalized, vendor-agnostic items that vendor offerings link to via `CrossRefs`. Categorized by `Category` and (where applicable) attributed to a `Manufacturers` record.
EDS.dbo.Category: Top-level product taxonomy (~134 rows). Small, stable lookup — used for browse, reporting rollups, and price-plan scoping.
EDS.dbo.Manufacturers: Manufacturer/brand directory (~9K rows). Note the legacy column spelling `Manufacturor` appears in some related tables — see quirks reference. Items reference a manufacturer; vendors do not.
EDS.dbo.BidHeaders: Bid solicitation header (~9.6K rows). One row per RFP/IFB/cooperative bid issued to vendors. Drives the bid-response window and ultimately produces `Awards`.
EDS.dbo.BidHeaderDetail: Per-line bid specifications (~123M rows — second-largest table in EDS). Holds the items, specs, and quantities a bid is asking vendors to price. Always filter by `BidHeaderId` before any analytical work.
EDS.dbo.BidRequestItems: Items the bid is asking about (~27.9M rows) — paired with `BidHeaderDetail` to define the buy. Vendor responses to these line items land in `BidResults`.
EDS.dbo.BidItems: Master list of items eligible to appear on bids (~27.5M rows). Distinct from `BidRequestItems` (request-time snapshot) — this is the catalog side.
EDS.dbo.Bids: Vendor bid response header (~147K rows). One row per (bid, vendor) submission, indicating intent to respond and submission status. Line-by-line responses are in `BidResults`.
EDS.dbo.BidResults: Vendor line-item bid responses (~33.2M rows) — the prices, lead times, and notes a vendor submitted for each `BidRequestItems` line they chose to bid on.
EDS.dbo.Awards: Bid award outcomes (~139K rows). Records which vendor's `BidResults` were chosen for each awarded line, including award date and award type. Awarded prices typically flow back into `CrossRefs` via a vendor catalog upload.
EDS.dbo.BidAnswers: Vendor responses to non-pricing bid questions (~552K rows) — terms, certifications, attribute confirmations.
EDS.dbo.District: Master record for a participating school district or other public entity (~979 rows). Top of the customer hierarchy. Budgets, approval chains, and price plans attach here. Treat as effectively static — bulk changes propagate everywhere.
EDS.dbo.School: Schools/buildings beneath a district (~6.6K rows). Used for ship-to address and reporting rollups; not a security boundary.
EDS.dbo.Users: Master user directory (~345K rows) — every person with login or named-recipient status across all districts. `Active` flag controls login eligibility; deletion is rare (audit references).
EDS.dbo.UserAccounts: Per-user budget account permissions (~3.4M rows). Joins users to the `BudgetAccounts` they're allowed to charge against. Drives the account dropdown shown when building a requisition.
EDS.dbo.BudgetAccounts: District budget accounts / charge codes (~1.4M rows). Hierarchical (often fund-function-object), district-scoped. Requisition lines distribute against rows here.
EDS.dbo.PricePlans: Named price-plan definitions (~585 rows) — controls which categories/vendors are visible to which districts at what pricing tier. Small but pivotal: changes here change what buyers see.
EDS.dbo.Audit: Generic audit log (~2.6M rows) — application-level events (logins, permission changes, data exports, admin actions). Distinct from the change-log tables, which are field-level.
EDS.dbo.TransactionLog_HISTORY: Long-tail historical event log (~124M rows). Cold storage — query with date filters and expect slow reads. Rarely needed for operational work; kept for compliance.
EDS.dbo.OrderBookDetail: Aggregated order/spending facts used by reporting (~37.8M rows). Fed from completed `PODetailItems`. The `OrderBookDetailOld` table (~187M rows) is the prior-format archive — read but do not write.
EDS.dbo.OrderBookDetailOld: Legacy archive of `OrderBookDetail` (~187M rows). Read-only; all new spend rolls up into `OrderBookDetail`.
EDS.dbo.ReportSession: User-facing report executions (~5.4M rows) — what reports were run, by whom, with which parameters.
EDS.dbo.ReportSessionLinks: Per-session output links (~52.7M rows) — joins a report session to the rows it generated, used to support drill-throughs and saved exports.
EDS.dbo.BatchDetail: Staging table for batch-imported requisition / order detail (~5M rows). Holds raw character-typed values (`OrigType`, `OrigDistrictCode`, `OrigCometCode`, `OrigItemCode`, `OrigQuantity`) alongside their resolved IDs so the importer can report and back-out errors. `ErrorField` flags malformed rows.
EDS.dbo.BidProductLinePrices: Manufacturer product-line discount tiers offered by a vendor on a bid (~1.3M rows). `RangeBase` is the dollar floor for the tier; `DiscountRate` is the percent off list. Joins a `BidProductLines` row to its tiered pricing structure.
EDS.dbo.BidMappedItems: Audit of item remapping decisions made during bid setup. Records the original `OrigItemId`, the chosen `NewItemId`, a `ReasonCode`, and the date — so award lineage stays explicit when a bid line is re-pointed at a different master item.
EDS.dbo.BidRequestPriceRanges: Quantity / dollar tier definitions a bid is asking vendors to price against (~1.9M rows). Tied to a `BidHeaderId` and (optionally) a manufacturer/product-line, with a `RangeBase` floor and `RangeWeight` used to compute the weighted bid score.
EDS.dbo.BidAnswersJournal: Append-only change history for `BidAnswers` (~1.3M rows). Captures the prior value, session, and modification timestamp every time a vendor edits a non-pricing bid response.
EDS.dbo.BidMSRPResultPrices: Per-tier MSRP-discount results submitted by a vendor on an MSRP-style bid (~423K rows). One row per `BidRequestPriceRange` per vendor result, with the discount-applied price.
EDS.dbo.BidRequestOptions: Optional bid-line attributes per (manufacturer, product line) — color, capacity, etc. Each row weights one named option for use in vendor evaluation.
EDS.dbo.EmailBlastLog: Audit of every transactional / marketing email sent from the platform (~1.5M rows). Captures sender, recipient, CC/BCC, send date, and the rendered XML payload. `Attachment` is the file name, not the content.
EDS.dbo.ImportDetail: Raw rows captured from a generic file import (~883K rows). One row of `ImportData` per source line, scoped to an `ImportId` header. Read after parsing to inspect malformed input.
EDS.dbo.IPQueueUsers: Per-user import-process queue assignments (~490K rows). Tracks `Requested`, `Started`, `Completed` timestamps and `Status` so background work can be parallelized and resumed.
EDS.dbo.POQueueItems: Outbound PO transmission queue (~401K rows). One row per PO send attempt, with `SendStarted`, `SendEnded`, `SendStatus` and a `PayloadId` referencing the rendered cXML / email body.
EDS.dbo.PricingConsolidatedOrderCounts: Demand-history counts feeding the consolidated-pricing analytics pipeline (~401K rows). One row per (`BidHeaderId`, `ItemId`) with `OrderCount` — used to weight bid evaluation by realized buying patterns.
EDS.dbo.RTK_ReportItems: New Jersey Right-To-Know chemical-reporting line items (~1M rows). Joins district + site + category + item + quantity, paired with `RTK_Sites` (locations) and `RTK_Items` (chemical detail). Feeds the annual NJ RTK survey.
EDS.dbo.DetailNotifications: Buyer-facing notifications about line-item changes (~3M rows). When a vendor substitutes or replaces an item the system writes a row here capturing the original vs. new `ItemId`, `VendorId`, and `BidPrice` so the buyer can review.
EDS.dbo.TaskSchedule: Bid-cycle / pricing-cycle work schedule (~1.5M rows). Tracks original, projected, and actual start/end dates for each task in a project, scoped by district, category, and price plan.
EDS.dbo.SessionTable: Active and recent user-session state (~12.8M rows). Holds the user's current district, school, requisition, PO, budget, mode, and screen state. Hot during business hours; queried heavily on every page load.
EDS.dbo.DMSVendorBidDocuments: Document metadata for vendor bid attachments stored in the document-management system (~750K rows). One row per uploaded file with `DocType`, `ExpirationDate`, page count, and a `DocId` GUID pointing into DMS storage.
EDS.dbo.CatalogTextParts: Tokenized catalog text for full-text search (~17M rows). One row per text fragment per `CatalogText` entry with a `BaseOffset` so the original text can be reassembled. Rebuilt during catalog imports.
EDS.dbo.HeaderWorkItems: Working set of items being aggregated into an OrderBook header (~492K rows). Transient — populated during OrderBook generation and emptied when the run completes.
EDS.dbo.DetailChanges: Quantity-change log on `Detail` lines (~26.5M rows). One row per qty edit capturing `OrigQty` / `NewQty` with `ChangeDate`, plus the surrounding `RequisitionId`, `ItemId`, `BidItemId`, `BidPrice` snapshot. Coarser-grained than `DetailChangeLog` (which is field-level across all columns) — this table tracks only quantity transitions.
EDS.dbo.BidResultChanges: Append-only edit log on `BidResults` (~18.2M rows). Records before/after `Active`, `UnitPrice`, `BidType`, and `Comments` whenever a vendor's bid response is modified. Pairs with `BidResultsChangeLog` which adds the user / reason context.
EDS.dbo.BidResultsChangeLog: User-attributed reason log for `BidResults` edits (~242K rows). One row per change action with `UserId`, `SessionId`, free-text `Reason`, and the surrounding requisition / detail / item / price context. Read alongside `BidResultChanges` for the full audit picture.
EDS.dbo.allitems: Denormalized flat snapshot joining `BidHeaders` × `Items` × `CrossRefs` × `Catalog` × `PricePlans` × `Category` (~6.3M rows). Reporting / working table — pricing, descriptions, vendor item codes, and order-vs-bid totals collapsed into one wide row. Rebuilt by batch jobs; not a system of record.
EDS.dbo.DebugMsgs: Generic application debug log (~23.7M rows) — one row per `Msg` with `LogDate`. Purely diagnostic; safe to truncate. The `_Orig` variant is an earlier rollover.
EDS.dbo.TransactionLogCF: Outbound HTTP request/response log for integration calls (~3.5M rows). Captures `URL`, `Method`, `Headers`, `Content`, request-start/end timestamps, target server, and session. Used to debug cXML / vendor-API integrations. Rolls over into `TransactionLogCF_Arc`.
EDS.dbo.TransactionLogCF_Arc: Archived rollover of `TransactionLogCF` (~31.6M rows). Same shape; cold storage for older integration request logs.
EDS.dbo.SecurityRoleUsers: User-to-security-role junction (~365K rows). Drives application-level permission checks — every effective role a user holds is one row here.
EDS.dbo.DistrictVendor: Per-district vendor enablement (~317K rows). FK to both `District` and `Vendors`; the `Active` flag scopes a vendor's visibility to a specific district, and `VendorsAccountCode` stores the district's internal account code with that vendor (used on POs).
EDS.dbo.DistrictCategories: Per-district overrides on the global `Category` taxonomy (~126K rows). Controls visibility (`Active`), surcharges (`Charge`), permission flags for addenda / incidentals / budget books / order books, RTK location, and display `Priority`. Treat as district-level configuration of the catalog browse experience.
EDS.dbo.Headings: Sub-category browse-tree headings under each `Category` (~306K rows). Can be district-scoped via `DistrictId`; `ExpandAll` controls default UI expansion. Drives the catalog browse hierarchy buyers see when shopping.
EDS.dbo.BidManufacturers: Bid-level manufacturer participation (~253K rows). One row per (`BidId`, `ManufacturerId`) with the negotiated `DiscountRate`. Aliased `BMA` elsewhere — referenced by `BidProductLines.BMAId`.
EDS.dbo.BidProductLines: Finer-grained discounts under a `BidManufacturers` row (~288K rows). Per-product-line (and per-`MSRPOptionId`) discount rate within the manufacturer's bid participation. Resolves the actual rate to apply when an item maps to a specific product line.
EDS.dbo.PriceRanges: Tiered MSRP / list-price brackets per (`CategoryId`, `ManufacturerId`, `ManufacturerProductLineId`) (~120K rows). `RangeBase` and `RangeWeight` parameterize price-based scoring used during bid evaluation and MSRP normalization.
EDS.dbo.PricingAddenda: Denormalized item-pricing snapshot used to render pricing addenda (~210K rows). Flattens `CrossRefs` + `Catalog` + `Heading` + `Keyword` + `Vendor` + `District` + `Award` into a wide row including catalog / list / last-bid prices, full description, and indexed text fields. Rebuilt by addendum jobs.
EDS.dbo.SafetyDataSheets: Master URL list of vendor SDS documents (~158K rows). Each row is a unique `SDSURL` with created / updated / deleted timestamps. Linked physical document blobs live in `SDSDocs`.
EDS.dbo.SDSDocs: Stored SDS document blobs (~161K rows). One PDF per row keyed to `ItemId` (and optionally `CrossRefId` / legacy `MSDSId`), with `OrigURL`, `Checksum` for dedup, and a varbinary(max) `Document`. The current SDS storage path; legacy MSDS data lives in `MSDS` / `MSDSDetail`.
EDS.dbo.MSDSDetail: Chemical-composition lines on a legacy MSDS sheet (~138K rows). Junction of `MSDS` to `RTK_CASFile` with `MixturePercent`. FK CASCADE on parent `MSDS`. Superseded for current ingestion by the SDS pipeline (`SafetyDataSheets` / `SDSDocs`) but still queried for historical sheets.
EDS.dbo.RTK_MSDSDetail: Right-To-Know variant of `MSDSDetail` keyed to `RTK_Items` instead of `MSDS` (~152K rows). Feeds the NJ RTK reporting flow alongside `RTK_ReportItems` and `RTK_CASFile`.
EDS.dbo.Images: Master image-asset record (~1.7M rows). Holds source URL, local paths (full / resized / thumbnail), perceptual hash (`pHash`, `bipHash`) for dedup, format / dimensions, and a `dateDeleted` soft-delete column. The single source of truth for product imagery referenced by catalog UI.
EDS.dbo.ImageLog: Image-fetch audit log (~1.8M rows). One row per HTTP fetch attempt with `statusCode`, `statusText`, `contentType`, response headers, and write outcome. Used to diagnose broken / stale image URLs sourced from vendor catalogs.
EDS.dbo.OrderBookLog: Print / render log for OrderBooks (~474K rows). Captures who printed which `OrderBookId` (district / school / user), how many items and pages were emitted, and the target `Device`. Operational telemetry, not a financial record.
EDS.dbo.SSOLoginTracking: SSO login event audit (~188K rows). One row per attempted SSO `Action` per (`SSOProvider`, `Email`) with `ErrorMsg` / `Description` payloads. Used to debug SAML / OAuth login failures.
EDS.dbo.ResetPasswordTracking: Password-reset email audit (~125K rows). One row per reset request with the issued `ResetPasswordCode`, target email, district / school context, and action / error payload. Indexed on `ResetPasswordCode` for verification.
EDS.dbo.Accounts: District-level account-code master (~111K rows). FK to `District` and `School`; referenced by `BudgetAccounts.AccountId` and `UserAccounts.AccountId`. The district-side identity that a `BudgetAccounts` row maps to before a user is granted access via `UserAccounts`.
EDS.dbo.OrderBooks: Master record for each printable OrderBook (~30K rows). One row per (`DistrictId`, `CategoryId`, `OrderBookYear`, `PricePlanId` / `AwardId`) — defines the catalog snapshot, markup, master-book role, and zero-page handling. Print events are logged in `OrderBookLog`; line items being assembled live in `HeaderWorkItems`.
EDS.dbo.UserTrees: Per-user approval-chain definition (~57K rows). For each (`DistrictId`, `UserId`) it lists the approvers, their `Level` and `ApprovalLevel`, and a `SortKey` that controls evaluation order. Drives which approvers populate `PendingApprovals` when a requisition is submitted.
EDS.dbo.BidRequestManufacturer: Bid-request side of `BidManufacturers` (~105K rows). One row per (`BidHeaderId`, `ManufacturerId`) the bid is *asking* vendors to respond on, with `SequenceNumber`, `AllowAdditionalProductLines`, and `UseOptions` flags. CASCADE FK to `BidHeaders`. Vendor responses come back via `BidMSRPResults`.
EDS.dbo.BidRequestProductLines: Bid-request side of `BidProductLines` (~176K rows). Lists the product lines under a `BidRequestManufacturer` row that vendors can respond to, with `UseOptions` and `Active` flags. Resolves which `ManufacturerProductLineId` rows the response form will offer.
EDS.dbo.BidMSRPResults: Vendor MSRP bid-response header (~41K rows). One row per (`BidHeaderId`, `BidImportId`, `ManufacturerId`) capturing the vendor's offered `DiscountRate`, write-in flags, supporting-document indicators (`AuthorizationLetter`, `SubmittedExcel`, `ProductCatalog`), and `WinningBidOverride`. Per-product-line detail is in `BidMSRPResultsProductLines`.
EDS.dbo.BidMSRPResultsProductLines: Per-product-line MSRP bid response (~110K rows). Lines under `BidMSRPResults` with the vendor's per-line `WeightedDiscount`, `MSRPOptionId`, and write-in product-line text. Resolves the actual rate applied for each product line in a vendor's MSRP response.
EDS.dbo.BidImports: Vendor bid-response import header (~56K rows). One row per (`BidHeaderId`, `VendorId`) captured from a vendor's submitted bid file, with `BidItemDiscountRate`, `CatalogDiscountRate`, `MinimumOrder`, free-delivery / free-handling terms, and `Status`. Pairs with `Bids` (response header) and `BidResults` (line items).
EDS.dbo.BidsCatalogList: Junction `Bids` ↔ `Catalog` (~85K rows). Lists which vendor catalogs a bid response covers, with the per-catalog `DiscountRate` the vendor is offering and the source `BidImportCatalogId`.
EDS.dbo.AwardsCatalogList: Junction `Awards` ↔ `Catalog` (~85K rows). Mirrors `BidsCatalogList` post-award — which catalogs the award covers and the awarded `DiscountRate` per catalog. The downstream effect of these rows is what flows into `CrossRefs` pricing.
EDS.dbo.BidHeaderDocument: Junction `BidHeaders` ↔ `BidDocuments` (~164K rows) defining which documents are attached to a bid solicitation, with `DisplaySequence` controlling order in the bid packet. Distinct from `DMSBidDocuments` which holds vendor-uploaded response attachments.
EDS.dbo.BidHeaderCheckList: Junction `BidHeaders` ↔ `BidderCheckList` items (~112K rows). Defines the checklist of items vendors must acknowledge to submit a response to a bid, with `DisplaySequence`.
EDS.dbo.DMSBidDocuments: Bid attachments stored in DMS — one row per uploaded file per bid (~29K rows). `DocId` is the GUID into DMS storage; `DistrictVisible`, `PagesCaptured`, and `FileName` are metadata. Companion to `DMSVendorBidDocuments` which is vendor-side.
EDS.dbo.PricingUpdate: Per-bid incremental-recompute marker (~60K rows). One row per `BidHeaderId` with `LastUpdated` — used to drive incremental updates to downstream pricing tables (`PricingAddenda`, `CrossRefs`) when only a subset of bids has changed.
EDS.dbo.MSRPExcelImport: Staging table for vendor-submitted MSRP price-list Excel uploads (~76K rows). Holds parsed rows from the spreadsheet (manufacturer, product-line group, delivery option, and up to seven (Base, Weight) tiers) before promotion into `BidMSRPResults*` / `PriceRanges`.
EDS.dbo.PostCatalogDetail: Post-catalog-import event log (~43K rows). One row per post-processing event under a `PostCatalogHeader`, capturing event type, description, value, and timestamp. Operational, not analytical.
EDS.dbo.DetailMatch: Repeat-purchase / re-order matching working set (~104K rows). For each `Detail` line it joins the `LastYearsQuantity` plus the full pricing snapshot (`BidPrice`, `CatalogPrice`, `GrossPrice`, `DiscountRate`, `AwardId`) so a buyer can be shown last-year quantities when building a new requisition. Rebuilt by batch jobs.
EDS.dbo.ApprovalsHistory: Historical / superseded approval rows (~342K rows). Same shape as `Approvals`; rows accumulate here when a requisition's approval chain is restarted (e.g. amount changed past a threshold) so the prior chain is preserved separately from the active one.
EDS.dbo.RTK_Items: Right-To-Know item catalog (~65K rows). Chemical-inventory items linked to `Items.ItemId` with NJ-RTK-specific attributes (CAS percent, container/UOM codes, legacy COMET code, manufacturer). Joined with `RTK_MSDSDetail` for chemical composition and `RTK_ReportItems` for survey output.
EDS.dbo.MSDS: Legacy MSDS sheet master (~59K rows). One row per MSDS document with `Active`, `CurrentVersionMSDSId` for chained revisions, and `ContentCentralMSDSDocId` pointing to the document blob in ContentCentral. Detail rows in `MSDSDetail` (CASCADE FK). Superseded for new ingestion by `SafetyDataSheets` / `SDSDocs`.
EDS.dbo.SDSResults: SDS URL crawl / validation results (~117K rows). One row per `SafetyDataSheet` with cache-, source-, document-, and Elastic-text validity flags plus per-channel error text. Used to identify broken or unindexed SDS records.
EDS.dbo.SDSSyncStatus: SDS-to-search-index sync status per `SafetyDataSheet` (~26K rows). Tracks `SyncedItems` / `SyncedRequisitions` against totals, separate item / requisition statuses, and start / end timestamps. Drives the SDS Elasticsearch backfill.
EDS.dbo.UNSPSCs: UNSPSC commodity-code reference (~50K rows). Industry-standard product taxonomy used to tag items for analytics and external reporting. Read-mostly lookup.
EDS.dbo.SearchSets: Saved search-filter criteria per session (~44K rows). One row per (`SessionId`, `CategoryId`, `CatalogId`) range describing the buyer's catalog-browse filter (`SearchBy`, `SearchStart`, `SearchEnd`). Transient session state.
EDS.dbo.CatList: Denormalized catalog mailing-recipient list (~155K rows). Snapshot of (district, school, category, price plan, attention, address) used when generating physical catalog / order-book mailings. Working table — rebuilt before each mail run.
EDS.dbo.CatalogText: Per-page extracted text for each catalog (~113K rows). One row per (`CatalogId`, `PageNbr`) with the original `BaseFileName` and OCR / extracted `TextData`. Powers full-text search; tokenized form lives in `CatalogTextParts`.
EDS.dbo.POQueue: Outbound PO transmission queue header (~27K rows). One row per (`UserId`, `VendorId`, `SessionId`) send request with `SendAddress`, scheduling fields, and free-text `OrderComments`. Per-PO send attempts are logged in `POQueueItems`.
EDS.dbo.POPrintTaggedPOFile: Staging table for the tagged-PO print pipeline (~121K rows). Holds the (district, PO, account, budget, bid-source) fields for each PO line being rendered into the printable, tagged PO file format. Working set — populated and consumed by print jobs.
EDS.dbo.POPageSummary: Per-PO line / page count summary (~73K rows). Aggregate of how many lines and printed pages a `POId` produces, scoped by district / category. Used by the print pipeline to size jobs.
EDS.dbo.CXmlSession: Punchout cXML session state (~67K rows). Captures the `PunchOutSetupRequest` envelope (from / to / sender domain & identity, payload ID, buyer cookie, BrowserFormPost) plus the EDS context (`RequisitionId`, `CategoryId`, `BudgetAccountId`, `Mode`) so the buyer can resume their requisition after returning from the supplier site.
EDS.dbo.VendorQueryDetail: Per-line vendor questions raised during bid evaluation / import (~135K rows). One row per query about a `BidResultsId` line with the `ItemQuery` text, send / resolved timestamps, and a `CommonVendorQueryId` to group related questions. Companion to `VendorQueryStatus`.
EDS.dbo.ItemUpdates: Per-item update log (~199K rows). Records `UpdateField` / `Action` taken on an `ItemId` with a `Reason` code. Used to audit catalog-side item edits driven by import jobs.
EDS.dbo.ProductVerificationResults: Automated product-verification results (~207K rows). One row per (`EntryId`, `QueryType`) — likely an LLM / rules-engine check — with `VerificationResult`, full `DataChecked` payload, and `Reasoning` text. Unique on (EntryId, QueryType).
EDS.dbo.ScanEvents: Document-scan event log (~396K rows). One row per file processed by a `ScanJobId` with `SourceFile`, `IndexData` payload, and `EventStatus`. Operational pipeline telemetry.
EDS.dbo.TransmitLog: Generic outbound HTTP transmit log (~156K rows). Captures `RequestURL`, `RequestParams`, and `RequestData` per request. Lighter-weight than `TransactionLogCF` (no response capture); used for fire-and-forget integration calls.
EDS.dbo.ImageErrors: Image-fetch error log (~27K rows). One row per failed image URL with the error text and `logDate`. Companion to `ImageLog` — `ImageLog` records every attempt; `ImageErrors` records only the failures with full error messages.
EDS.dbo.BidMgrTagFile: Bid-manager tagging working set (~4.4M rows). Per-user (`Usr`) tag overlay against a target table (`Tbl`) and row pointer (`Ptr`) with current and original tag values. Used by the bid-management UI to track in-progress tag changes before persistence.
EDS.dbo.TaskEvent: Bid-cycle task event log (~122K rows). One row per event against a `ProjectTaskId` with date, scoping district / category / user, and a free-text `ValueField`. Pairs with `TaskSchedule` — `TaskSchedule` holds the planned dates, `TaskEvent` records what actually happened.
EDS.dbo.TMAwards: Trades-bid awards (~94K rows). One row per (`BidHeaderId`, `BidTradeCountyId`, `VendorId`) — the awards layer for the trades / services bid track (mirrors `Awards` for commodity bids). `AwardAmount` and `AwardType` recorded.
EDS.dbo.TMSurveyResults: Trades-vendor survey responses (~98K rows). Per (`TMSurveyId`, `TMVendorId`, `BidTradeCountyId`) `Rating` and free-text `Comments` from district survey of trades vendors. Feeds vendor-performance scoring on the trades track.
EDS.dbo.ShippingVendor: Vendor-specific shipping methods (~39K rows). Junction `Vendors` × `Shipping` with the vendor's own `ShippingCode` and `Active` flag. Drives the shipping-method options shown when a buyer picks delivery for a vendor's PO.
EDS.dbo.BatchBook: Staging for batch requisition / budget-account loads (~218K rows). One row per inbound record from a district batch file with the parsed `DistrictCode`, `CometCode`, `AccountCode` resolved to surrogate IDs (`DistrictId`, `BudgetAccountId`, `UserAccountId`), input vs. calculated amounts, duplicate / amount validation flags, and the resulting `RequisitionId`. Working set for the batch import pipeline.
EDS.dbo.Budgets: District budget periods (~16K rows). One row per (`DistrictId`, `Name`) covering the period between `StartDate` / `EndDate` with separate `VisibleFrom` / `VisibleUntil`, `EditFrom` / `EditUntil` windows, an `EarlyAccess` flag, and `AnnualCutoff`. Drives which budget a requisition rolls against and when buyers can see / edit against it.
EDS.dbo.Batches: Batch-import job header (~14.5K rows). Parent of `BatchBook` rows — captures `BatchDate`, `Type`, `SourceId`, lifecycle timestamps (`Scheduled`, `Started`, `Loaded`, `Imported`, `Converted`, `Completed`), input / imported record counts, total `Amount`, and `ErrorCount`. One row per file ingestion attempt.
EDS.dbo.NextNumber: PO / requisition / receiver sequence generator (~25K rows). One row per (`DistrictId`, `SchoolId`, `BudgetId`, `IdType`) sequence with `Prefix`, `Suffix`, `NextNumber`, `EndNumber`, formatting flags (`SuppressLZ`, `NumberLength`, `ActualNumber`), and a free-form `FFMessage`. Atomic increment here is what produces the next PO number for that scope.
EDS.dbo.Keywords: Search / browse keywords attached to a `Category` and optional `Heading` (~25K rows). District-scoped via `DistrictId`. Drives keyword-based catalog navigation; tied into pricing rollups via `PricingAddenda.KeywordId` and `HeadingKeywordId`.
EDS.dbo.Units: Unit-of-measure lookup (~11K rows). Tiny reference; `Code` is the human-readable UoM (EA, CS, BX, …) referenced by `Detail.UnitId`, `PricingAddenda.UnitId`, and elsewhere.
EDS.dbo.TopUOM: Per-`Category` default UoM ranking (~4.6K rows). Maps `CategoryId` → `UnitId`; UI uses this to pre-select the most likely unit when a buyer adds an item from a category.
EDS.dbo.ManufacturerProductLines: Manufacturer product-line master (~14K rows). One row per (`ManufacturerId`, `Name`) with `Active` and `UseOptions` flags. Referenced from `BidProductLines.ManufacturerProductLineId`, `BidRequestProductLines`, `BidMSRPResultsProductLines`, and `PriceRanges` to resolve which product line a bid line covers.
EDS.dbo.DistrictPP: District ↔ `PricePlans` junction (~9.3K rows). Lists which price plans a district has access to. FK to `PricePlans`. Combined with `VendorCategoryPP` (vendor / category visibility per plan), this is the primary control on what catalog the buyer sees.
EDS.dbo.VendorCategoryPP: Per-(vendor, category, district, price plan) visibility row (~18K rows). Determines whether a vendor's items in a given category appear to a district under a specific price plan. Combined with `DistrictPP` and `DistrictCategories` to compute catalog visibility.
EDS.dbo.VendorCategory: Vendor-by-category directory (~6.9K rows). Lighter-weight than `VendorCategoryPP` — one row per (`VendorId`, `CategoryId`) with the denormalized `VendorName` and a marketing `WebLink`. Used in directory / search displays where the price-plan dimension isn't needed.
EDS.dbo.ShipLocations: District ship-to address master (~6.9K rows). One row per delivery location (`DistrictId` scoped) with full address, contact, and `LocationCode`. `RTK_SitesId` ties the location to its NJ Right-To-Know site. Selected on POs / requisitions to set the delivery destination.
EDS.dbo.RequisitionNotes: Free-text notes attached to a requisition (~25K rows). One row per note with `RequisitionID`, `Note` body, `CreateDate`, `CreatedByUserID`. Recipients of email notifications about each note are tracked in `RequisitionNoteEmails`.
EDS.dbo.RequisitionNoteEmails: Per-note email-recipient list (~17K rows). Junction `RequisitionNotes` × `Users` — one row per user that should be emailed when a note is added.
EDS.dbo.CSMessages: Per-user customer-service / banner messages (~12K rows). Free-text `CSMessage` shown to a specific `UserID` on login. Lightweight in-app notification channel, distinct from the email-driven `EmailBlast`.
EDS.dbo.DistrictNotifications: District notification routing rules (~6K rows). Per (`DistrictId`, `NotificationType`, optional `CategoryId` / `UserId`) — defines `Method`, `NotifyList`, and `OtherNotify` so the system knows where to send each event class for that district.
EDS.dbo.EmailBlast: Saved email-blast definitions / send history (~18K rows). One row per blast — name, HTML body, recipient `SQLStmt` and `ReportWhereClause`, `EmailFrom`/`CC`/`BCC`/`Subject`, attachments, priority and read-receipt flags, and `SentDate` once dispatched.
EDS.dbo.Suppression: Email / contact suppression list (~6K rows). Per `Email` / `Phone` / `Locator` row with `SuppressionType`, `Reason`, and `Handled` flag. Filters outgoing communications across the platform.
EDS.dbo.BidImportCatalogList: Junction `BidImports` ↔ `Catalog` (~33K rows). Per-catalog discount terms a vendor has offered as part of a bid response. Resolves into `BidsCatalogList` once the response is accepted, and into `AwardsCatalogList` after award.
EDS.dbo.BidImportCounties: Junction `BidImports` ↔ `BidTradeCounties` (~65K rows). Lists which trade-counties a vendor's bid response covers, with `Active` and free-text `Comments`. Trades-bid scoping data.
EDS.dbo.BidTradeCounties: Trade × County junction (~43K rows). Defines the geographic scope of each `BidTrade` (NJ counties or other regions). Referenced by `BidImportCounties`, `TMAwards`, `TMSurveyResults`.
EDS.dbo.BidRequestItemMergeActions: Bid-request line dedup ledger (~37K rows). When two `BidRequestItems` are merged during request preparation, one row records the source and `DestinationBidRequestItemId` and a `Merged` flag. Lets the system keep the surviving line and trace where eliminated rows went.
EDS.dbo.BidQuestions: Bid question/answer template (~24K rows). One row per question on a `BidTrade`, with display geometry (X/Y/Width/Height for both question and answer fields), text, expected `QuestionQty` / `QuestionUOMId`, and `AnswerTypeId` / `AnswerTypeMask`. Drives the bid form vendors fill out; responses land in `BidAnswers`.
EDS.dbo.BidDocument: Bid solicitation document templates (~11K rows). One row per reusable document (`DocumentTitle`, `DocumentType`, body text). `BidHeaderDocument` joins these to specific `BidHeaders` for a packet.
EDS.dbo.SaxDups: Bid-import dedup helper (~31K rows). Per (`BidHeaderId`, `PackedCode`) tracks which packed item codes have been seen so the SAX-style streaming bid parser can skip duplicates.
EDS.dbo.VendorQuery: Vendor-query (clarification) header (~12K rows). One row per email/fax sent to a vendor about a bid response — `BidHeaderId`, `VendorId`, `BidImportId`, sent / receipt-confirmed timestamps, full `MessageContent`, and contact addresses. Per-line questions are in `VendorQueryDetail`; status transitions are in `VendorQueryStatus`.
EDS.dbo.VendorQueryStatus: Status timeline for a `VendorQuery` (~31K rows). Per-status-transition row with `StatusDate` and `FollowUpDate`. Pairs with `VendorQuery` (the message) and `VendorQueryDetail` (the per-line questions).
EDS.dbo.Awardings: Bid-award run header (~11K rows). One row per (`BidHeaderId`, `StartTimestamp`) recording when an award computation ran, when it ended, how many notifications were created, and when they were sent. Operational header — the actual award rows land in `Awards`.
EDS.dbo.FreezeItems: Bid-window price freeze list (~15K rows). One row per (`BidHeaderId`, `ItemId`, `CrossRefId`, `VendorId`) capturing the `GrossPrice` snapshot taken at freeze time so prices can't be altered after a vendor's response window closes.
EDS.dbo.VendorSessions: Vendor-portal session tracking (~11K rows). One row per vendor login session — `VendorId`, `UserName`, `jSession` token, `StartTime` / `EndTime`, `IPAddress`, and `VPORegistrationId`. Distinct from `Users` (district-side) sessions.
EDS.dbo.VendorOrders: Per-(vendor, PO) integration state record (~5.8K rows). Holds vendor-side response payloads (`VendorData` JSON, `VendorStatus`) and `LastUpdated` for any vendor that returns acknowledgement / shipment data via integration.
EDS.dbo.DMSVendorDocuments: Vendor-supplied compliance / qualification documents stored in DMS (~6.5K rows). Per-vendor (`VendorCode`) document with `DocType`, `ExpirationDate`, `DocumentNumber`, `PagesCaptured`, `FileName`, and a DMS `DocId` GUID. Distinct from `DMSVendorBidDocuments` (bid-attached) and `DMSBidDocuments` (bid-side).
EDS.dbo.UserAdminLog: User-administration action log (~6.5K rows). One row per admin operation — `submituserid` acting on `targetuserid`, the `action` string, full `commitString` payload, and `actionDate`. Audits user-create / role-change / disable events.
EDS.dbo.IPQueue: Generic in-process / import-process job queue (~5K rows). One row per job — `Queue` name, target `Email`, lifecycle timestamps (`Requested` / `Started` / `Completed`), and `Status`. The header that `IPQueueUsers` (per-user assignments) hangs off of.
EDS.dbo.ImportMessages: Per-import-process message log (~5.5K rows). One row per `Message` with `MsgDate` against a `ProcessId`. Lower-level than `Batches` (header) — captures the human-readable progress / warning text emitted during an import run.
EDS.dbo.DistrictCharges: District-billed charge ledger (~22K rows). Per-district recurring or one-off `Amount` charges with `ChargeTypeId`, `Frequency` / `Repeats` / `FrequencyData` for recurrence, `Invoiced` timestamp, and the `BudgetId` to bill against.
EDS.dbo.DistrictProposedCharges: Proposed-but-unapplied district charges (~12K rows). Pre-application staging row capturing the proposed `Amount`, `PreviousAmount`, `ChangePercentage`, `Action`, and timing — moves into `DistrictCharges` when applied (`DateApplied` set).
EDS.dbo.DistrictContinuances: Annual continuance / renewal sign-off per district (~14K rows). Per (`DistrictId`, `BudgetId`) record with `Status` ('P'ending → received), `SignedBy`, `Email`, `Sent` / `Received` timestamps, free-text `Comments`, and an optional `SavingsBudgetId`. Tracks the contractual rollover document each district returns each budget year.
EDS.dbo.DistrictContacts: District contact directory (~3.8K rows). Named contacts of a given `DistrictContactTypeId` per district — full name parts, salutation, phone / fax / email, and a postal address (which can be linked to a `ShippingId`). Used for billing, RFP, and notification routing.
EDS.dbo.YearlyTotals: Per-(`BudgetId`, district) annual savings rollup (~11K rows). Wide reporting row totalling bid / catalog / state-contract costs and savings, included vs. excluded buckets, and overall percent savings / discount. Output of the annual savings calculation; consumed by reporting.
EDS.dbo.CopyRequests: Requisition / PO copy-job tracker (~25K rows). One row per copy operation initiated from a session — `RSId` source, `SessionId`, requested / start / end timestamps. Used to drive the async copy worker.
EDS.dbo.POTempDetails: PO-creation working table (~4K rows). Holds in-flight PO line context (PO number parts, `RequisitionID`, `VendorID`, `BidHeaderID`) under a `POTempID` while a PO is being assembled — populated and consumed during PO conversion.
EDS.dbo.POLayoutDetail: Per-PO-layout field placement (~6.9K rows). For each `POLayoutId`, defines the position, size, wrap, literal text, optional embedded image (varbinary), and `PrintWhen` rule for each `POLayoutFieldId`. Drives the print rendering of POs in the chosen template.
EDS.dbo.SulphiteDetail: Working table for Sulphite (Industries) bid item resolution (~6.3K rows). Maps `Detail.DetailId` → resolved `ItemId` via `vendorItemCode` / `ItemCode`. Vendor-specific helper used to align an established Sulphite-supplied item code to the master `Items` row during requisition processing.
EDS.dbo.PostCatalogHeader: Catalog-post pipeline run header (~3.6K rows). One row per (`CatalogId`, post run) with `PostDateStart` / `PostDateComplete`. Per-event detail in `PostCatalogDetail`.
EDS.dbo.ImportCatalogHeader: Catalog-import pipeline run header (~3K rows). Symmetric to `PostCatalogHeader` but for the inbound side — `ImportDateStart` / `ImportDateComplete` per `CatalogId`. Detail rows live in `ImportCatalogDetail`.
EDS.dbo.ImportCatalogDetail: Per-event log under an `ImportCatalogHeader` (~19K rows). Captures `ImportInfoType`, `ImportInfoDesc`, `ImportInfoValue`, and timestamp for each pipeline event during a catalog import run.
EDS.dbo.RTK_CASFile: Right-To-Know CAS-number reference file (~7.9K rows). Master chemical record per `CASRegNo` with chemical / DOT / substance numbers, trade-secret designation, and dozens of NJ-RTK hazard flags (`SpecialHealthHazard`, `Carcinogen`, `Mutagen`, `Teratogen`, `Corrosive`, flammability / reactivity tiers, etc.). Joined by `MSDSDetail` and `RTK_MSDSDetail` to identify constituents.
EDS.dbo.RTK_FactSheets: NJ Right-To-Know Hazardous Substance Fact Sheets (~2.5K rows). Per-substance reference — `CommonName`, `ChemicalName`, `CASNumber`, `DOTNumber`, `HazardCodes`. Soft-deleted via `Deleted` timestamp.
EDS.dbo.RTK_LegacySchoolFile: Legacy NJ-RTK school-file mapping (~6.8K rows). Maps the old (`LegacyDistrictCode`, `LegacySchoolCode`, `NJEIN`) identifiers + `ExposedEmployees` count to current `DistrictId` / `RTK_SitesId`. Read-mostly; preserved so historical RTK exports can be reproduced.
EDS.dbo.TMVendors: Per-year trades vendor list (~16K rows). One row per (`TMYear`, `TradeId`, `CountyId`, `VendorId`) with denormalized `VendorName` and `Sequence`. Defines who is eligible to bid on a given trade in a given county for a given year.
EDS.dbo.CalendarDates: Named-calendar date set (~2.3K rows). Each `CalendarId` can hold up to four meaningful dates (`Date1`–`Date4`) with a description — used for budget cycles, bid windows, and other scheduling lookups.
EDS.dbo.Calendars: Master calendar definitions (~300 rows). One row per (`BudgetYear`, `ScheduleId`, `CalendarTypeId`) with `Description` and HTML / plain-text `HeaderText` / `FooterText` for printable calendar output. Date set per calendar lives in `CalendarDates`.
EDS.dbo.Counties: U.S. counties lookup (~78 rows). Tiny reference — `(State, Name)` per `CountyId` with a `StateId` link. Referenced by `BidTradeCounties`, trades-bid scoping, and address rollups.
EDS.dbo.Trades: Trades hierarchy (~107 rows). Self-referencing tree (`ParentId`) of trade categories used for the trades-bid track, with `Description`, `Comments`, `PackageNumber`, and `pwRequired` (prevailing wage). Parent of `BidTrades` (per-bid trade rows) and `TM_UOM` etc.
EDS.dbo.TM_UOM: Trades-bid UoM lookup (~77 rows). Description-only reference (e.g. 'Hour', 'Each', 'Square Foot') used by the trades / T&M bid forms. Distinct from the catalog `Units` table.
EDS.dbo.BidTrades: Per-bid trade definition (~1.6K rows). One row per (`BidHeaderId`, `TradeId`) with `Title` and full `Specifications` text — the trade-specific scope inside a bid solicitation. Parent of `BidQuestions` (CASCADE FK).
EDS.dbo.PPCatalogs: Junction `PricePlans` × `Category` × `Catalog` (~1.7K rows). Determines which catalogs are visible under a price plan for a category, with the `DiscountRate` and the linking `AwardId`. The price-plan side of catalog visibility (vs `BidsCatalogList` / `AwardsCatalogList` which are bid-side).
EDS.dbo.PPCategory: Junction `PricePlans` × `Category` (~1.5K rows) with `AllowAddenda` flag. Controls whether buyers on a given price plan can add catalog addenda for that category.
EDS.dbo.BidPackageDocument: Junction `BidPackage` ↔ `BidDocument` (~1.5K rows). Defines which documents are bundled into a reusable bid package (template), with `DisplaySequence`. `BidPackage` then attaches in bulk to `BidHeaders`.
EDS.dbo.BidDocumentTypes: Bid document type lookup (~298 rows). Per `BidType` and optional `State`, defines the document categories used in bid packets (`Name`, `Description`, `Sequence`, `Grouping`) along with flags for vendor-specific, vendor-unique, expiration tracking, district visibility, and one-of-many display.
EDS.dbo.BidderCheckList: Master list of bidder-checklist items (~140 rows). Per-checklist item: `CheckListText`, optional rich-text help, document-name / type, and flags for `OptionalDocument`, `OnFileEligible`, `UploadEligible`, `ExpirationDateReqd`, `DocNumberReqd`, `DocNumberLabel`. `BidHeaderCheckList` is the per-bid junction.
EDS.dbo.BidderCheckListPkgHeader: Bidder-checklist packages (~56 rows). Tiny header table — named, active-flagged groupings of checklist items. Detail rows in `BidderCheckListPkgDetail`.
EDS.dbo.BidderCheckListPkgDetail: Junction `BidderCheckListPkgHeader` × `BidderCheckList` (~1.2K rows) with `DisplaySequence`. Defines which checklist items live in which package; packages are the reusable building block bound onto a `BidHeader`.
EDS.dbo.BidReawards: Re-award events (~615 rows). One row per (`BidHeaderId`, `ReawardDate`) with `EffectiveFrom` / `EffectiveUntil` and `Comments` — captures when a bid's awards were partially or fully redone (e.g. winning vendor dropped out) and the validity window of the new state.
EDS.dbo.VendorQueryTandM: T&M (Trades / Time-and-Materials) variant of `VendorQuery` (~1.9K rows). Same shape as `VendorQuery` but scoped to the trades-bid track. Header for clarification messages sent to trades vendors about their bid response.
EDS.dbo.VendorQueryTandMStatus: Status timeline for a `VendorQueryTandM` (~1.9K rows). Per-transition row with `StatusDate` / `FollowUpDate`. CASCADE FK to `VendorQueryTandM`.
EDS.dbo.VendorQueryTandMDetail: Per-line T&M vendor queries (~1.2K rows). Mirrors `VendorQueryDetail` for the trades track, with extra `TandMQueryType`, `TandMQueryCounties`, and `ResolvedFlag`.
EDS.dbo.VendorQueryMSRP: MSRP variant of `VendorQuery` (~140 rows). Clarification-message header scoped to MSRP-bid responses. Same structure as `VendorQuery`.
EDS.dbo.RTK_Sites: NJ Right-To-Know facility / site master (~823 rows). Per (`DistrictId`, `NJEIN`) site with `FacilityName`, mailing address, facility-location lines, `CoMunCode`, `ChemicalInventoryStatus`, exposed-employees count, and emergency-contact info. Linked from `ShipLocations.RTK_SitesId` and `RTK_LegacySchoolFile.RTK_SitesId`. Reporting target for the annual NJ RTK survey.
EDS.dbo.RTK_Inventories: Annual chemical-inventory record per RTK site (~658 rows). One row per (`RTK_SiteId`, `RTK_InventoryYear`) with `RTK_InventoryDate`, `RTK_InventoryBy` submitter, and free-text `RTK_InventoryNotes`. Drives the date-stamped 'inventory taken' attestation on the RTK report.
EDS.dbo.RTK_LegacyDistrictCodesMap: Legacy district-code translation table (~78 rows). Maps the historical (`Legacy_DistrictCode`, `SQL_DistrictCode`) two-character codes onto the modern surrogate `DistrictId`. Read-mostly; lets historical RTK / batch files reference districts by their old codes.
EDS.dbo.TMSurvey: Trades-vendor survey header (~862 rows). One row per district survey submission with `Submitter`, `Title`, `Email`, `Started` / `Finished` timestamps, and `CountyId`. Per-vendor scores live in `TMSurveyResults`; new-vendor / new-trade write-ins live in `TMSurveyNewVendors` / `TMSurveyNewTrades`.
EDS.dbo.TMSurveyNewVendors: Free-text 'new vendor to consider' entries on a `TMSurvey` (~202 rows). Captures vendor name, address, and contact info from districts suggesting vendors not yet in the trades pool.
EDS.dbo.TMSurveyNewTrades: Free-text 'new trade to consider' entries on a `TMSurvey` (~89 rows). Captures suggested trade name and description from districts requesting new trade categories.
EDS.dbo.ShippingRequests: Shipping-quote requests sent to vendors (~728 rows). One row per (`RequisitionId`, `VendorId`) ask, with `EmailAddresses`, `Comments`, `RequestSent` / `RequestCompleted` timestamps, `RequestStatus`, `loadingDock` flag, and a `ShippingRequestUniqueId` GUID for vendor-side reply linking. Cost replies populate `ShippingCosts`.
EDS.dbo.ShippingCosts: Per-line shipping cost lookup (~1.1K rows). One row per (`DetailId`, `RequisitionId`) with `Quantity`, `Cost`, `UpdatedBy`, and an optional link to the originating `ShippingRequestId`. Surfaced on POs that need explicit shipping line items.
EDS.dbo.ImportProcesses: Import-job process run history (~754 rows). Per (`ImportId`, `ProcessDate`) — one row each time the process step ran for a given `Imports` job. `ImportMessages.ProcessId` references this row.
EDS.dbo.Imports: Catalog / data-import job header (~301 rows). One row per import attempt — `ImportType`, `ImportDate`, `Records`, `ErrorCount`, target `CategoryId`, `PricePlanId`, and up to six `CatalogId1`–`CatalogId6` slots being loaded simultaneously. Companion to `Batches` (which is requisition-side).
EDS.dbo.UserImports: User-import staging table (~328 rows). Excel-derived columns with literal spaces in their names (`User #`, `Approver User #`, `Approval Level (Teacher/Principal/BA)`, `Account Code`, `Amount`). Working set for batch creation of district users; promoted into `Users`, `UserAccounts`, and approval trees.
EDS.dbo.MSRPExcelExport: Staging table for exporting MSRP responses to Excel (~563 rows). All columns typed as varchar so the export can preserve raw text. Mirror of `MSRPExcelImport` for the outbound direction.
EDS.dbo.SDS_Rpt_Bridge: Working bridge for SDS reports (~100 rows). Per (`SessionId`, `ItemId`) → `SDSDoc` mapping populated mid-run when generating an SDS-by-requisition report so the report can join consistent results without re-running the SDS resolver.
EDS.dbo.DMSSDSDocuments: DMS pointer for legacy MSDS documents (~602 rows). Per `MSDSId` row holding the DMS `DocId`, `PagesCaptured`, and `DocName`. Older / parallel storage to `SDSDocs` (which is the current binary store) — the two diverge by ingestion vintage.
EDS.dbo.Notifications: Per-recipient notification send log (~720 rows). One row per (`UserId`, `Email`, `EmailBlastId`) send with `DateSent`, `NotificationType`, and the rendered `EmailHTMLTable` payload. Receipts / delivery audit for blasts and other notifications.
EDS.dbo.BatchDetailInserts: Audit of line-inserts produced by batch loads (~1.2K rows). One row per (`RequisitionId`, `BatchDetailId`, `ItemId`, `qty`, `SourceId`) showing what each `BatchDetail` row produced when expanded into requisition lines. Sequential-GUID PK.
EDS.dbo.POLayouts: PO print layout master (~636 rows). Defines named templates with `FormLength` / `FormWidth`, `ContinuousFeed` flag, copy count, and `FormType`. Field placement under each layout lives in `POLayoutDetail`.
EDS.dbo.POLayoutFields: PO-layout field catalog (~56 rows). Defines each field that can be placed on a PO (`POLayoutField` name, type, `POLayoutSource` SQL fragment to resolve the value, and `DetailField` flag for line-item-vs-header). Referenced by `POLayoutDetail.POLayoutFieldId`.
EDS.dbo.AccountingUserFields: Per-district accounting-format field definitions (~80 rows). For an `AccountingFormatId`, defines the position, name, and required-flag of each user-supplied field that makes up a district's account string (e.g. fund/function/object/location segments).
EDS.dbo.DistrictNotes: District-level free-text notes (~77 rows). Lightweight per-district memo with `NoteTitle`, single-char `NoteType`, `Note` body, and `DateOfNote`. Operational comments visible to admin staff.
EDS.dbo.SecurityRoleKeys: Junction `SecurityRole` ↔ `SecurityKey` (~65 rows). Defines which security keys (permission flags) belong to each role. `SecurityRoleUsers` then maps users to roles.
EDS.dbo.Carolina Living Items: Carolina Living vendor-specific items snapshot (~2K rows). Vendor-specific working table; preserved as a frozen item set referenced by their feed, similar in spirit to other vendor-named snapshots in `Catalogs.dbo`.
EDS.dbo.SulphiteUsers: Users authorized to act on Sulphite-specific workflow (~1.2K rows). Vendor-scoped allowlist tying `UserId` to the Sulphite ingest / matching path that uses `SulphiteDetail` / `SulphiteImport`.
EDS.EDSIQWebUser.TableOfContents: Per-OrderBook table-of-contents entries (~6.7K rows). One row per heading on a printed OrderBook with `Title`, `PageNbr`, and `OrderBookId`. Used by the IQ web reporting layer to render TOC pages.
EDS.VMS.vw_Login: Vendor-portal login lookup view. Used by the vendor-management UI to authenticate and resolve a vendor's accessible bids.
EDS.VMS.vw_BidsByVendor: Vendor-portal view listing bids visible to each vendor — the per-vendor cut of `BidHeaders` joined with award status. Drives the vendor's bid-list screen.
EDS.EDSIQWebUser.OrderBookView: Reporting view over consolidated order data — top-level grain, suitable for dashboard summaries.
EDS.EDSIQWebUser.OrderBookDetailView: Reporting view exposing line-level OrderBook detail — the drill-through target from `OrderBookView`.
EDS.EDSIQWebUser.POAccountList: Reporting view listing PO line items by budget account — used for budget-utilization reports.
Catalogs.dbo.Master Catalog: Consolidated cross-vendor master catalog used as the import target for catalog file processing (~144M rows — the largest table on the server). Read-heavy; rebuilt by the catalog-import pipeline.
Catalogs.dbo.CatalogImports: Catalog-import job audit (~405 rows) — one row per upload run, capturing source, status, and outcome counts.
Catalogs.dbo.uniqueCodes: Dedup helper for catalog imports (~331K rows) — tracks unique vendor part / item codes already seen so subsequent runs can skip duplicates.
Catalogs.dbo.Grainger Jan 2019: Frozen snapshot of the Grainger January 2019 catalog feed (~1.5M rows). One of several Grainger snapshots in this DB (`Grainger Jan 2015`, `…Jan 2016`, `…Jan 2017`, `…Jan 2017 Revised`, `…Feb 2018`, `…May 2018`, `…May 2017`, `…May 2016`). Kept for historical pricing comparisons.
ProcurementAnalytics.dbo.Entities: Customer entities (districts and other public organizations) participating in cooperative procurement — analytics-side master record. Distinct from `EDS.dbo.District` and includes additional analytics fields like `StudentCount`, `Population`, `Region`.
ProcurementAnalytics.dbo.Vendors: Analytics-side vendor master. Smaller and cleaner than `EDS.dbo.Vendors` — kept in sync via the analytics ETL.
ProcurementAnalytics.dbo.Contracts: Cooperative-contract master used for spend analytics. Captures contract value, term, negotiated savings, status, and auto-renew settings per (vendor, contract).
ProcurementAnalytics.dbo.PurchaseOrders: PO header — analytics flatten of EDS PO data with denormalized department / cost-center / project-code fields and lifecycle dates.
ProcurementAnalytics.dbo.PurchaseOrderLi: PO line detail joined back to its `PurchaseOrders` header. Holds qty, unit price, line total, UoM, and received qty for variance analysis.
ProcurementAnalytics.dbo.SpendTransactio: Atomic spend events feeding the analytics fact tables. Each row pairs a PO line with a contract (or `IsOffContract = 1` for maverick spend) plus fiscal-period attributes.
ProcurementAnalytics.dbo.EntitySpend: Bridge linking an `Entity` to a `SpendTransaction` so spend can be rolled up by entity without re-traversing the PO chain.
ProcurementAnalytics.dbo.VendorPerforman: Periodic vendor scorecards — on-time-delivery percent, quality, defect rate, responsiveness, cost competitiveness, and overall score. Drives vendor ranking and renewal recommendations.
ProcurementAnalytics.dbo.EntityVendors: Many-to-many of which vendors each entity transacts with, including the relationship start date and a primary-vendor flag.
ProcurementAnalytics.dbo.EntityBudgets: Per-entity, per-fiscal-year budget allocations by category. `AllocatedAmount` is the original amount; `AmendedAmount` reflects mid-year revisions.
ProcurementAnalytics.dbo.BudgetAllocatio: Org-level budget allocations (department / cost center / project / category) used as the rollup target for entity-level spend analytics.
EDS.dbo.Vendors.Active: Tinyint flag (0/1) controlling whether the vendor is visible across the platform. Setting to 0 hides the vendor's catalogs and bid responses everywhere — system-wide effect, not a soft delete.
EDS.dbo.Vendors.Code: Short alphanumeric vendor code (≤16 chars) used as a human-friendly identifier on POs and reports. Distinct from `VendorId` (the surrogate key).
EDS.dbo.Vendors.DistrictId: When non-null, marks this vendor as district-specific (only visible to that district). When null, the vendor is platform-wide.
EDS.dbo.Vendors.UseGrossPrices: Tinyint flag (0/1). If 1, this vendor's pricing is interpreted as gross (list) prices that must be discounted against bid terms. If 0, prices are net.
EDS.dbo.CrossRefs.Active: Tinyint flag (0/1) controlling whether this cross-ref appears in catalog browse / search results. The 1 → 0 transition is the normal soft-deactivate path; rows are rarely physically deleted.
EDS.dbo.CrossRefs.CatalogPrice: Vendor's catalog (list) price for this item, in dollars. The price actually charged to a buyer is computed by applying the bid/award discount on top of this value — see `GrossPrice`.
EDS.dbo.CrossRefs.GrossPrice: Pre-discount price used when the parent vendor has `UseGrossPrices = 1`. The discounted price = `GrossPrice * (1 - discountRate)`.
EDS.dbo.CrossRefs.Manufacturor: Manufacturer name as text (note the legacy typo: `Manufacturor`, not `Manufacturer`). Use the normalized `ManufacturerId` FK instead for joins; this column is kept for historical / legacy display.
EDS.dbo.CrossRefs.DoNotDiscount: Boolean-as-int flag. Non-zero means the system must NOT apply bid discounts to this cross-ref — used for special-deal items priced at net.
EDS.dbo.CrossRefs.DateDeactivated: Set when `Active` flips to 0. NULL for currently-active cross-refs.
EDS.dbo.Detail.DetailId: Surrogate primary key. Stable across the requisition → PO conversion; line items keep the same `DetailId` once they migrate from req-only to PO-attached.
EDS.dbo.Detail.RequisitionId: FK to `Requisitions`. Always set — every line item belongs to a requisition. Combined with `RequisitionId`-based filtering for any per-req query.
EDS.dbo.Detail.POId: FK to `PO`. NULL while the line is still on an unconverted requisition; set when the requisition reaches final approval and converts to a purchase order. Use `WHERE POId IS NULL` to find req-only lines.
EDS.dbo.Detail.ItemId: FK to `Items` (the master product). NULL for free-text / off-catalog lines. When set, prefer joining via `CrossRefId` to get vendor-specific pricing.
EDS.dbo.Detail.CrossRefId: FK to `CrossRefs` — the specific vendor-priced row this line was built from. Captures the vendor and price at requisition time. NULL for free-text lines.
EDS.dbo.Detail.VendorId: FK to `Vendors`. The vendor this line is being purchased from — denormalized from `CrossRefs` for performance.
EDS.dbo.Detail.BidHeaderId: FK to `BidHeaders` — which bid award this price came from. Important for spend-by-bid reporting and for verifying that the captured price still reflects an active award.
EDS.dbo.Detail.BidPrice: Per-unit price at requisition time, in dollars. The frozen price the requisition is being approved against; line total = `BidPrice * Quantity`. Independent of the live `CrossRefs.CatalogPrice` (which can change).
EDS.dbo.Detail.Quantity: Units ordered. Integer; fractional quantities are not supported on this table. Combined with `BidPrice` to compute line total.
EDS.dbo.Detail.Active: Tinyint flag (0/1). 0 marks a line as soft-deleted / cancelled; rows are rarely physically removed because of audit references in `DetailChangeLog`.
EDS.dbo.PODetailItems.PODetailItemId: Surrogate primary key for the immutable PO line snapshot. Distinct from `DetailId` — one `Detail` row produces exactly one `PODetailItems` row at conversion.
EDS.dbo.PODetailItems.POId: FK to `PO`. Always set — every PO line item belongs to a purchase order.
EDS.dbo.PODetailItems.DetailId: Back-link to the originating `Detail` row. Lets you trace from a PO line back to the requisition history.
EDS.dbo.PODetailItems.ItemId: FK to `Items`. Frozen at PO issuance — does NOT update if the master `Items` row changes later.
EDS.dbo.PODetailItems.VendorId: FK to `Vendors`. The vendor this PO line ships from — frozen at PO issuance.
EDS.dbo.PODetailItems.BidPrice: Per-unit price locked in at PO issuance, in dollars. Contractual — does not change even if the source bid is later re-awarded or `Detail.BidPrice` is edited.
EDS.dbo.PODetailItems.Quantity: Units ordered, locked in at PO issuance. For receiving variance, compare against the receiving-side tables, not against `Detail.Quantity`.
